caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, stylized decorative motif with a central large urn-like shape. The urn is peach in color with a reddish-brown dotted outline, two ornate side handles, and a rounded top finial with a light blue circle. Inside the urn, there are light brown and reddish-brown accent shapes and florals, including a central flower form with a blue center and scalloped edges. Below the urn, there is a rectangular band featuring a repeating diamond pattern filled with alternating blue and peach colors, bordered by red lines. Surrounding the urn, floating in the upper left and right corners, are two small blue-outlined floral motifs with red centers and greenish accents. The background is light beige, and the overall composition features muted tones of peach, blue, red, brown, and green, with stylized geometric and floral patterns. There is printed text below identifying this as a wall painting from the Purisima Conception Mission and notes it is part of the "Decorative Art of Spanish California" series by the WPA Art Project of Southern California.
title: Mission La Purisima Concepcion Wall Painting from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
